details.label: INCORRECT
details.reasoning: The answer includes Switzerland, but it also asserts that Poland joined the club at the same time. That conflicts with the gold target identifying Switzerland as the most recent nation to join.
details.groundedness_reasoning:
1. The citations identify Switzerland as a country crossing the trillion-dollar threshold in 2025, the latest year shown.
2. They also show Poland crossing in 2025, so they do not establish Switzerland as the sole most recent entrant.
3. Since Switzerland is explicitly one of the countries in the latest entrant cohort, the gold answer is supported, with the qualification that Poland joined in the same year.
